hatchet
This is a short-hafted light axe, not designed for throwing.
It is bladed only on one side, and attacks with this weapon
are fairly fast and damaging.
It is a Fast (speed 9) weapon.
sickle
This is a sharp curved crescent of iron. The Druids use this
to cut mistletoe and such plants for their woodland worship.
In a pinch, it can do decent damage, but it is unwieldly.
short-spear
This is a short thrusting spear, used in one hand and
usually with a shield. It can do decent impaling damage, and
is a favourite of woods dwellers who have to worry about
hitting trees with a swing.
scimitar
This is a curved sword, about three feet in length, and
bladed upon one edge. It is thin, and fairly light, but can
deliver considerable slashing wounds.
It is a Fairly Fast
speed 7) weapon.
greatsword
This is a long, heavy, four foot long sword. It is quite
sharp and deadly, and is bladed on both sides. This two-
handed sword can inflict massive damage in battle, but can
only be used effectively by the very strong. It can punch
through the best plate mail with ease.
flamberge
This is a medium-sized, wavy-bladed greatsword. It is
lighter and faster than a conventional greatsword, and
inflicts less damage. It is still extremely effective in
combat, however.
bastard sword
This is a light two-handed sword. It is about three and a
half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a
greatsword. It is fairly fast and damaging, and is overall
a good weapon.
greataxe
This is a heavy, long-hafted, double-bladed axe. It is very
sharp, and its massive head can inflict horrible wounds on
and opponent. It is very slow and unwieldly, but armour is
almost useless against it as it punches right through.
halberd
This is six-foot pole with an axe head mounted at the top.
It is extremely slow, and is quite clumsly to wield, but the
damage its huge, arcing swings can inflict is unmatched.
pike
This is a six-foot-long spear. It is too long to be used
very well, but provides good defense, and does considerable
damage.
It is a Moderately Slow (speed 5) weapon.
long-spear
This is a four foot long spear, used with both hands. It is
fairly quick and is a good defensive weapon, but it does not
do great damage.
It is a Fairly Fast (speed 7) weapon.
glaive
This is a heavy blade mounted on the end of a six-foot pole.
It is only bladed on one side, and is used with a harsh
chopping motion. It is slow and clumsy, but does very good
damage.
mace
This is a steel ball mounted on a two-foot wooden rod. It
is a well-rounded weapon, providing adequate defense and
attack. This is the weapon of choice for Priests and the
like.
morning-star
This is a spiked steel ball, attached by chain to a two-foot
wooden rod. It does good damage, as when it is swung the
ball reaches great speeds, but is not too fast or wieldly.
heavy-mace
This is a heavy steel ball mounted on a wooden handle. It is
fairly large and heavy, and does good damage. It is mainly
used by the stronger of the Priesthood.
club
This is a knob-ended piece of wood. It is generally a poor
weapon, doing decent damage but being comparatively slow.
Its main advantage is that it is readily available.
warhammer
This is a martial version of the tool by the same name. It
has a heavy, flattened head on one side, and a blunt spike
on the other. The damage it can do is considerable, but due
to its weight is is fairly slow.
spiked club
This is a rod with jagged nails stuck through it. It is not
very quick or effective against armour, but can do good
damage against unarmored foes as the nails rip through them.
It is mainly used my impoverished thugs who cannot afford
any better weapons.
whip
This is a four-foot-long braided leather whip. Overall, it
is not a very good weapon, as it is used mainly to entangle
and to cause pain.
war mattock
This is a large, heavy, square-headed mace with a flat end.
It does good damage and is a fairly good weapon.
It is a
airly Fast (speed 7) weapon.
maul
This huge, two-handed mace is nearly six feet in length. It
is so massive that you have difficulty even lifting it, and
the damage it does in combat must be incredible, although it
is incredibly slow. Only the strongest can wield this weapon
with any effect.
It is an Extremely Slow (speed 1) weapon.
quarterstaff
This is a six-foot wooden staff, bound about the middle with
strips of cloth. It is a simple weapon, and does not deal
very much damage, but provides good defense as it is quite
quick to use.
iron-capped staff
This is a staff with iron caps on the ends. It does more
damage than a conventional staff, but is also slower due to
the added weight.
It is a Fast (speed 8) weapon.
flail
This is a large, two-handed morning star. It is heavy and
extremely damaging, as well as being slow and poor on the
defensive side. It is a good weapon for brawny warriors who
prefer blunt weapons.
battle-hammer
This is a large, two-handed sledgehammer. It is very heavy
and quite slow, but the damage it does in battle is
considerable.
iron staff
This is a wooden staff with an iron core. It is quite heavy
for its size, and is not as easily maneuvered as a regular
staff, but it also does more damage.
It is a Fast (speed 8)

sandals

wall
This smooth wall is made of carefully-fitted bricks. As you
examine it, you push one of the bricks slightly, and you
find a secret door!
crack
There is a small crack in the wall here. Investigating it
further, you find a small button!
tapestry
This is an elaborately-woven tapestry, made of red and gold
thread. It depicts a battle between a griffon and a dragon,
their bodies entwined one around the other. Moving it aside,
you see a small crack in the wall.
hole
This jagged hole is about four feet in diameter, and looks
as if it was made by some extremely powerful beast. Peering
in, you can see the shadowy recesses of a cavernous tunnel!
fountain
This beautiful alabaster fountain gleams in the light. It is
carved to ressemble the arched neck and head of a dragon,
and it spews water into a large circular dish in the form of
a clamshell.
statue
This is a white marble statue of a ten foot tall knight in
full plate armour. He stands resting both hands on the
pommel of his sword, and his shield rests up against the
wall. Although his face cannot be seen through his visored
helmet, he conveys a feeling of sorrow.
The statue looks as if it could rotate upon its base.
sword
The knight's massive bastard-sword is intricately engraved
with ancient runic symbols. It is nearly six feet long, and
even though this must be a stone duplicate of the real
weapon, it appears to be razor-sharp.
shield
This massive curved shield must weigh a thousand stone, if
it was possible to move it. Its face is engraved with the
intricate carving of a rearing griffon. The skill of the
stonemason is such that it seems like it is ready to leap
out at you!
griffon
The carved griffon is detailed exquisitely. Each claw and
feather is defined so exactly that it must have taken years
to complete. The griffon's beak appears as sharp as a sword
blade, and its eye shines like a star... but upon closer
inspection, you see that the eye is actually a button!
jeweled longsword
This exquisitely-crafted blade is honed to a razor-sharp
edge, and its blade is embellished with highlighted runes
and engravings. Its hilt is encrusted with glittering gems
of all sizes, and its pommel is fashioned in the form of a
dragon's claw gripping a blue sapphire.
glowing warhammer
This large, one-handed warhammer shines with a soft blue
glow. It appears to be made of a dark metal, and although
looks heavy is in fact quite easy to swing. Its flat, broad
head is ornately carved with sigils of power.
black star key
This black iron key's head is shaped like a circled five-
pointed star. You get a faint feeling of distaste when
touching it.
high-necked robes
These long, voluminous robes have a stiff, high-necked
collar which gives a very dramatic appearance to the wearer.
The deep green of the robes is offset by brilliant golden
runes which adorn the cuffs and hem, and a golden sash
around the waist keeps it closed.

with a single eye-sized sapphire at the brow.

This is a thick, slow-burning wax candle, with a short
string wick. It may be lit to provide a little light, and is

torch
This long wooden stick is bound by stips of oil-soaked
cloth. When lit, it provides fairly good illumination, and
in a pinch can be used as a weapon.
lantern
This is a small iron lantern, its glass bulb protected by
shutters. When filled with oil and lit, it provides very
good illumination, and may be refilled.
bone key
This small, fragile-looking key appears to be made of bone.
It is quite cold to the touch.
black shield
This heavy black iron shield is emblazoned with a red
horned skull. It is quite heavy, but is large enough to
provide good protection from attacks.
tomb door
This large stone door is carved with holy images and
symbols. A large plaque in the centre is engraved with an
elaborate script, but the age of the writing is such that it
is indecipherable to you.
stone door
This huge stone portal is completely plain except for a
black keyhole set in the exact centre of its grey face.
Spidery runes are carved all about this hole, in a script
which you have never seen before.
sarcophagus
This white stone coffin is seemingly carved out of one huge
piece of rock, and is made in the likeliness of the long-
dead noble for who it was commissioned. You can see no seam
or binding which would enable it to open.
lever
This simple iron lever is set in the centre of an steel
plate. Its round knob is dull and smoothed by much use.
manhole
This is a three foot wide hole in the centre of the street,
covered by a perforated stone cover which allows the stream
of water and refuse to drain into the sewers.
iron sink

sharp, spearpoints. Its once-intricate craftmanship is now
marred by the thick brown rust coating its surface and its
bent bars. Creeping weeds entwined between its bars
completely block your view past the fence.
chained door
This large wooden door is locked by a heavy iron chain,
bolted to iron loops affixed to the warehouse's walls.
Though on the surface the chains look unbreakable, they are
in fact old and somewhat rusted, and with some work and the
right tools they could be broken.
western wall
This wall is extremely clean compared to the rest of the
sewer-- in other words, it is not outright filthy. A thin
layer of slime and mould covers its surface, as well as an
abnormal number of small black holes.
small black holes
Looking into some of the small black holes, you discover a
smooth metal stud lurking within one of them!
smooth metal stud
This is a small metallic button, and appears to be well-
used. It moves slightly at your touch.
table
This is a rather ordinary-looking wooden table, made to
last. Its thick face and legs are heavily nicked and cut
with use.
chair
This is a plain wooden chair, its little ornamental carving
smoothed away by much use. Its seat is likewise smoothed,
and its legs and back are nicked from being pushed into
things.
book
stove
This fat black wood-burning stove is covered in grease and
soot, and appears to be heavily used. It stinks of burnt
flesh and fat.
fireplace
This large stone fireplace is covered in soot, and holds a
bubbling cauldron full of a rank-smelling stew. The fire is
burning the evil-looking weeds outside in the garden, and
they give off a greasy black smoke that makes you gag.
ancient door
This huge ancient door is elegantly decorated with delicate
scrollwork and stylized vines. It appears to have weathered
the years quite well, and is nearly as strong as it was when
it was new. A square lock gapes from its right side, though
the key to this door must be long lost.
hills
These hills are made of a light grey rock, almost the colour
of powdered bone, and are run through with veins of a deep
metallic red. Their faces are sheer, sharp, and unscalable,
and rumour tells that the red veins are actually rivulets of
blood from adventurers who have tried to scale their
heights.
road
This is a poorly-maintained gravel road, covered with dirt
and debris. Black weeds occasionally poke through its
surface. It is hard to tell whether the road is frequented
alot by a few people, or infrequently by many, as the tracks
are obscured by those of what you presume to be animals'.
wooden sign
avalanche of jagged rubble
This massive pile of collapsed stone is completely
impassable, as the stones are both too large and too sharp
to handle. However, several man-sized holes can be seen
leading inside the rubble, and although it would be
dangerous, one or a few of them may be passable.
displacer beast tentacle
This is the jet-black severed tentacle of a displacer beast.
A mass of bony spikes protrude from the end, and it looks as
though it would make an effective weapon.
manticore tail
This huge, heavy tail is tipped with a heavy bone ball
covered in long spikes. The spines are iron-hard and sharp
as razors, and make this tail a deadly weapon, although its
extreme weight doesn't allow much in the way of speed.
longbow
This slender, curved bow is made out of a long branch of
supple wood. It is tightly-strung, and has a fair amount of
stopping power. Its pull is a little heavy, but it makes for
a good, accurate weapon. It comes with a quiver full of
black-feathered arrows.
composite bow
This long, fabulously crafted bow is made of horn and light
wood, and is pulled taut buy a gut string. The strength and
range are unmatched, with the exception of the more powerful
crossbows.
black serpent key
This glossy, sinuous key depicts the form of a serpent with
red glinting eyes. The teeth of the key are oddly curved as
well, and any lock this key fits must be of a completely
different construction than normal locks.
piece of black chitin
This is a large, mostly undamaged piece of a violet-black
chitin. It is flexible, able to be bent fairly easily, but
is also extremely strong and hard to puncture.
path
This is a narrow gravel path, threading its way through the
confusing labyrinth of hills known as the Dragon's Teeth. It
is somewhat difficult to keep one's bearing, as all the
hills look nearly the same, and the sheer rocky faces are
too tall and jagged to climb for a good look at the
surroundings.
two-headed morningstar
This heavy weapon consists of a leather-bound oak rod about
two feet in length, attached to a pair of ball-tipped
chains. The metal balls are covered in blunt protrusions to
cause more damage. A golden tassle hanging off the pommel is
its only ornamentation.
gnarled wand
This foot-long wand seems to be made out of a blackened oak,
its length filled with twisting convolutions. Carved in the
side of the wand in a crude, jagged script is the word
"Shirzak".
large canvas tent
This is a simple, but effective, heavy cloth tent. It is
quite big, having room for about a dozen well-sized people,
and seems to be populated by at least that many, if the
sprawled bedrolls and miscellaneous debris are anything to
go by.
massive canvas tent
This huge tent appears to be of relatively good make, and is
supported in the middle by a heavy wooden pole. Apparently
it only houses one being, as there is only one bed, the rest
of the room being filled with odd knicknacks, large skulls
hung on the walls, and an impressive collection of dull
shoddy weapons.
bonfire
This huge crackling bonfire shimmers and spits, its greasy
smoke rising up into the sky. A thick hank of meat run
through with an iron spit roasts within its flames.
scroll with black seal
walls
The walls of these tunnels are made of a light grey stone,
run through with metallic veins the colour of blood. They
are deeply gouged in places, though what could tear stone
with such ease remains to be seen.
hole
The black hole in the ceiling here is too high to reach, and
appears to lead upwards at a steep slant.
hole
This four foot wide hole appears to have been roughly carved
out with some extremely sharp digging instrument... or

small hole
This dark hole is about four feet across, and appears to
lead down into the depths of the hill.
green bubbling pool
This wide, bubbling pool smells light and sweet, like the
scent of flowers on a breeze. It glows from within,
illuminated by a soothing green glow. The shore of the pool
does not seem treacherous, and it would be easy to drink
straight from the pool, or fill up a container with it.
crystal flask
This crystal bottle is quite well crafted, and would hold a
few mouthfuls of liquid.
glowing crystal flask
This small crystal bottle is filled with some sort of slowly
bubbling green liquid.
composite bow

silver-laced quiver of white leather is full of black-
feathered arrows, their points sharp as razors.
golden snake earrings
This pair of small golden earrings are crafted in the shape

hoops. Their eyes glitter with tiny emeralds, and the scales
seem to have been crafted one by one.
curved black dagger
This large, thin-bladed dagger is extraordinarily heavy for
its size, and is nearly as long as a shortsword. Its blade
is heavily carved with softly glowing red runes, and there
is a decidedly evil aura surrounding it.

the milky-white fluid which covers them, and pale white eggs

impossible to distinguish what race each body is, as they
have been mutilated beyond recognition.
partially digested body
This is the body of a creature of unknown race, its skin
melted away, a milky fluid covering it. Its flesh is

violet organic walls
These strange-looking walls are made of a hard, sticky,
violet substance that smells faintly sweet. They are formed
in organic patterns, with swirling rounded designs. Although

alien, and somewhat disturbing.
partially concealed hole
This large hole is somewhat hidden by a number of tentacle-
like organs forming a crude door. The pulse and move as you
watch them. The hole is easily wide enough to allow entry.
black mountains
The stone of these mountains is coal black and as sharp as
flint. It is shot through with thin metallic red veins,
which reflect the light with crimson sparkles. This mountain
range is known to be practically unscalable, and is nearly
devoid of plant life. Very few creatures can survive in such
harshness, and those that do are deadly.
crevice trail
This is a narrow rocky trail passing along the bottom of a
natural crevice in the mountain. Occasionally there is a
small, but unfathomably deep crack to leap over, and often
the trail is nearly blocked by fallen rocks and rubble.
There is evidence of tracks of some sort, though the rocky
terrain makes them unidentifiable.
thick brown vines
These heavy, almost leathery vines vary in thickness from
one inch to almost four. They appear quite strong, and could
possibly bear the weight of someone climbing upon them.
filthy nests
These nests are extremely disgusting and dirty, being filled
with rotting meat, debris, and various worthless odds and
ends. Bits of bone and leather are scattered about, as well
as broken pieces of weapons and armour.
severed head
This is the gruesome, bloody head of Commander Markus of the
Western Garrison. His once-proud eyes are now glazed and
lifeless, and his once-dark skin is now pale and clammy. His
swollen tongue lolls grotesquely out of his mouth.
locked wooden box
This small, heavy, rectangular box appears to be made of
polished darkwood. Its corners are capped with shining iron,
and it has a heavy lock on it.
crossbow
This powerful weapon is comprised of a small, but extremely
powerful metal bow affixed to a two-foot-long wooden stock.
The bow is extremely difficult to cock, making this a slow
weapon-- but its steel-tipped bolts can pierce through
armour with ease. It comes with a quiver full of short,
sharp bolts.
heavy crossbow
This is a more powerful version of the standard crossbow.
Its bow is very tightly strung, and requires much strength
to re-cock, making it very slow to fire. Nonetheless, it is
extremely accurate, and armour is nearly useless against its
heavy bolts. It comes with a quiver full of the small,
weighty, steel-tipped bolts it requires.
sling
This is a simple leather thong, with a pouch affixed to its
middle. To use, a stone is placed within the pouch, then the
sling is whirled about at great speeds. When one end of the
sling is released, the stone flies at the target. It comes
with a pouch full of smooth, round stones.
staff-sling
This weapon looks like a shortish wooden staff, with a
leather sling affixed to the end. It is able to throw stones
faster and further than a normal sling, but it is slower and
requires two hands. It comes with a pouch full of stones to
use.
grey rolled parchment
This thin piece of parchment is covered in spidery letters.
After scanning the document, you discover it is instructions
on the learning and casting of a spell named Frenzy! The
effects of Frenzy are to increase combat accuracy, damage,
and speed, while reducing all defenses.
tattered scroll
This long, ripped scroll is covered by row upon row of
thin, evenly-spaced handwriting, describing the methods of
learning and casting a spell named Mass Frenzy! This spell
duplicates the effects of the Frenzy spell, but is cast upon
oneself and one's allies.
holy writ
This thin manual describes the ways of properly praying to
one's deity in order to be filled with righteous power! This
Righteousness gives the target an increase in combat power,
coupled with a small healing of one's wounds over time.
skin-covered book
In this unholy manual, you uncover the evil, secret
techniques of the blood ritual! This Blood Ritual allows the
recipient to be filled with a minute power of the Blood God,
giving an increase in combat power along with a small amount
of healing over time. This spell is powered by the pain and
suffering of others, and is needless to say quite evil.
barkskin scroll
This thick, weathered bark scroll is inscribed with many
passages written in a bold, flowing hand. Upon scanning its
contents, you discover that it contains the secret methods
of learning and casting the Regeneration spell! This
powerful, but short-lived spell rapidly heals the target's
wounds.
double crossbow
This strange contraption appears to be a heavy crossbow with
two bows, one on top of the stock, the other on the bottom!
The bolts are held in an ingenious auto-reloading magazine,
which must be reloaded every so often. Cocking both bows and
reloading the magazine makes re-arming this weapon fairly
slow, but the firing of it is quick as lightning.
rapier
This excellent weapon has a three-foot length of thin
sharpened steel, designed for thrusting and lunging. It is
marvellously balanced, and greatly improves defense as it is
so quick to maneuver.

pewter door

black and white serpent ring

thief's kit

pewter tankard
This is a heavy pewter tankard, dented from extreme use in

dead cat

ruby-eyed skull ring

massive black doors

alleyway

street

the street have a decidedly seedy and unkempt look about
them.
iron sign

golden honeycomb
This large, delectible honeycomb drips with the glittering
golden honey of the killer bees.
smoky black talisman

wooden skiff

log raft

bushes

uick to use.

silvery pool

silvery stream

you, and occasionally a stone falls with a loud splash into
the waters near you.
huge fallen tree

stuck in some rocks in the centre of the river, and careful

ancient statues

thousands of years ago, judging from their unfamiliar style

the statues' ancient, scarred faces.
huge stone

manastone

skull wand

wand glow with a dull, fiery red.
black cauldron

carved wall face with design

elevated rocky ledge

pale green lichen

dark brown walls of stone

rocky waterfall

long bridge

dark forest

woods, and there appears to be no place to land at its foot.
silvermere wall
The massive town wall of Silvermere once was used to keep

severed head of Goru-Nezar

ebony kris

black ichor, which steams and foams when it hits the ground.

barbed spear

swamp tree. Its head is made of sharp steel, hooked and
barbed to cause painful injury.
shadowy marsh

be strangling its neighbours. A chill fog covers the marsh
floor, and wet slurping sounds are often the only indication
that a perilous watery pit is just ahead. Mysterious lights
flicker in the dark recesses of the marsh, and the feeling
that you are being watched is unshakeable.
curved fang

that there is some liquid inside that sloshes when you

giant pearl

milky-white color reflects rainbow colors in the light.
spider silk trousers

strands of a fine fabric form each thread, and the stitching
appears made of some golden fabric, each one appearing to
form a sparkling rune.
bone necklace
Bones of all shapes are thread together by a single green
vine, tied at the back. Each one seems to rattle on their
own volition, causing you to think that they might be
imbued with some magic power.
dented wizard's hat
This pointed hat is decades old, and from the dirt you
wonder if it has ever been washed. Despite the grime you
see many stars and magic runes running along it's length
and along the brim. You note some of the stains would
indicate the last owner had befallen tragedy.

to carry comfortably and toss easily. It is also perfect
size to entrap a man.
javelin

used as a grip in the middle of the pole, and the ends

stone javelin

not tell if it is chiseled stone, or petrified wood,
but regardless it feels very sturdy. The pole has a
sharp point at each end.
mithril plate leggings

shining brightly in the light. They appear very heavy,

fashioned by a master-smith.
mithril chain leggings

can tell by their shine that they've been made of
dwarven mithril, and wonder if they belonged to some
lord or powerful warrior.
wyvernhide trousers
These thick leather trousers are made from the hide of
some reptilian beast. The brown scales are incredibly
durable, and you can tell they provide protection that
would rival any suit of platemail.
black leather leggings
This pair of leather leggings is made from a glossy black
leather which seems to absorb the surrounding light. It does
not weigh much at all, and is very flexible.
chameleon leggings
You can tell by the ways the leggings change shade that they
were made from the skin of some color changing beast. They
feel extremely comfortable and look like they can afford
ample protection.
red chitin leggings
These bizarre leggings appear to have been made out of the
shell plates from some gigantic red crustacean. They are
tied together by some glowing vines of some sort, and it
appears to have been treated with some mixture that gives
it a fine sheen.
red chitin helm
This red helmet has been made out of the head plate of
some monster crustacean. It feels very durable for its
slight weight, but the two holes left from the eye
stalks still remind you of its origin.
red chitin armour
This red suit of armour is made up of several shells of
some massive crab-creature. It feels incredibly tough
and has been tied together by several glowing vines,
and they seem to have been treated with some strange
mixture that makes it give off a glow.
red chitin shield

chitin of some large sea-monster. They are interlocked
together and tied by some strange glowing vines. It is
very light and you wonder if any weapon could pierce
its surface.
sapling longbow
This slender bow is made out of the sapling of some
outlandish forest. The string used is a single glowing
vine, that is tightly wound to the ends of the bow. It
comes with a quiver full of similar sapling-like
arrows, feathered together with a tree-leaf.
bloodstained chakram
Red stains cover this circlet of strange metal, and as you
grab it you feel an intense sense of evil. Black runes seem
to pulsate from the large circle, and you wonder what evil
deeds it has done. Much smaller then a regular sized chakram
it is small enough to use for stealthy attacks.
bronze chakram

with the weapon being one foot in diameter.
ethereal chakram

with strange smokey runes radiating from its edges. As you
look at the circlet closer it seems like some shifting cloud
is inside.
giant spiked collar
This collar is crafted from hard leather and appears to have
belonged to some giant animal. On its lowest fastening, you
think you could probably make it fit. Its sharp spikes are
wickedly curved, and anyone wearing this would definitely
look cruel and menacing.
fur-lined pouch
This pouch fastens around your waist like a belt, except
it's two sizes too big. Upon opening you see many bits of
bone, wood and herb inside, it obviously belongs to someone
schooled in witch doctoring.
gargantuan stone maul
This looks like a gigantic rock with a metal shaft coming
out of it. The head is two feet in diameter, and is very
heavy. It is so massive you have a hard time lifting it off
the ground. You try a couple of practice swings and the
weight almost takes your arms off.
giantwood club
This was obviously a tree branch of some thousand year old
tree before it was fashioned into a rough club. It is
gigantic in size and would have to have belonged to a huge
monster. It is six feet in length, you could barely lift it
yourself, however you can tell anything struck with this
would have to take a step back or be flattened.
lionskin belt
This fine belt was made from the hide of some animal and
then tanned. It feels very thick, and is buckled with a
piece of gold, finely crafted into the image of a lion. It
is heavy to wear around your waist, but still makes a nice
fit.
lionskin tunic

brown. The center is inlaid with a finely crafted symbol of
a lion. From the feel of the tunic it's very hard to pierce,
and the lining is made from a fine fur. The craftsmanship
looks a little clumsy, but still durable in a fight.
great spiked club

crudest fashion. Gigantic in size, it could be stood on its
end and be taller than most men. Anyone who could even
wield this would be a force to be reckoned with.
petrified stone corselet
A gigantic piece of stone makes up this "corselet". It is
roughly chiseled to look like plate armor, but that doesn't
change that it's still a massive piece of stone. It would
fend off just about any attack on your torso, you only to
worry about the rest of your body when wearing this
massive corselet.
stormmetal greataxe

made of a bizzare metal that gives off a blueish tinge as
white lightning runs up and down the razor-like edge. As you

to give off an odd hum as it weaves through the air.
stormmetal scalemail
This entire suit is enchanting to behold, the metal lights
up all over with lightning, giving the entire suit a
blueish tinge. The circles of metal are all tightly woven
together to make a hard-to-pierce suit. You note the suit
was worn by a very large man as you put it on and have to
adjust the straps to fit your smaller frame.
stormmetal bracers

lightning charge running along the length of the bracers
giving it a blueish tinge. The metal is incredibly sturdy,
etched in runes of some strange language of power. The
bracers are oversized but will still fit.
storm crown

thundercloud hidden deep in the gem.
titanic stone maul

combatant, you see by the stains on the stone that it's
already found many victims.
beaded belt

warm feeling seems to radiate with each glow.
silver belt

shadow bracelet

seems to eat at the surrounding light. Running your finger
along it gives you a strange cool feeling.
thief's pouch
